solution_approach.problem: I need to automate the generation of standup notes to save time and ensure consistency in team updates.
solution_approach.approach: I'm building an automated system that pulls information from GitHub commits, Linear issues, and recent activity to generate comprehensive standup notes.
implementation_steps: I'm integrating with GitHub API to track my recent commits and pull requests
I'm connecting to Linear to fetch my assigned issues and their current status
I'm creating a template system that formats the information in a structured standup format
I'm adding logic to summarize what I completed yesterday, what I'm working on today, and any blockers I'm facing
I'm implementing automatic generation that runs daily before standup meetings
features: Automatic detection of completed work from GitHub commits
Integration with Linear to show issue progress
First-person narrative format for natural standup notes
Blockers detection from issue status and comments
Time-based filtering to show only relevant recent work
solution_approach.current_status: I'm in the active development phase, working on integrating the GitHub and Linear APIs to pull the necessary data for note generation.
next_steps: I'll finish the API integration for both GitHub and Linear
I'll refine the template to make the notes sound natural and conversational
I'll add error handling for cases where APIs are unavailable
I'll test the system with my actual work data to ensure accuracy
I'll schedule the automated generation to run before daily standups
challenges: I'm working on ensuring the notes capture the right level of detail - not too verbose but informative enough
I need to handle cases where I have multiple issues in progress simultaneously
I'm figuring out how to detect blockers automatically from issue comments and status changes
notes_in_first_person: Yesterday I completed the initial API integration for GitHub and started working on the Linear connection.
